terminal_name: Trident Energy Congo FLNG Terminal (Nkossa / Nsoko II)
issue: USER-FLAGGED MISS (2026-06-24). The June africa discovery sweep failed to surface Trident Energy's proposed Congo FLNG. Trident acquired ~85% operated interest in the Nkossa/Nsoko II offshore fields in 2025 and is advancing a 'Nkossa Gas Project' FLNG planned as SHARED basin infrastructure (able to take associated gas from multiple operators), aligned with Congo's Oct-2025 Gas Code and flaring-reduction Gas Master Plan; the CEO has publicly stated they are 'expediting' it (~3-year commissioning target).
